podcast.body: Bob Welch re-recorded his 1972 Fleetwood Mac song "Sentimental Lady" as a solo single in 1977. Christine McVie co-produced it, Lindsey Buckingham played guitar and provided backing vocals, and Mick Fleetwood played drums. Released in the fall of 1977, his solo spin-off reached number eight in January 1978. "Christine even sprinkled her hit making fairy dust on an old friend when she helped former band made Bob Welch re-record his 1972 Fleetwood Mac song, Sentimental Lady, as a solo single."

podcast.body: This catchy soft rock track was generated by Bob Welch for Fleetwood Mac's 1972 album *Bare Trees*. Despite its alluring sound, the song was unable to crack the charts in America, reflecting the band's commercial struggles at the time. "He generated Bear Trees' catchiest single, the soft rock sentimental lady."
